```python
def _class(source, pos):  # source[pos] == '['
    i = pos + 1
    items = []
    n = len(source)
    while i < n and source[i] != ']':
        ch, i = _class_char(source, i)
        if i + 1 < n and source[i] == '-' and source[i+1] != ']':
            hi, i = _class_char(source, i + 1)
            items.append(Range(ch, hi))
        else:
            items.append(Range(ch, ch))
    if i < n:  # consume ']'
        i += 1
    if not items: return Empty(), i
    if len(items) == 1: return items[0], i
    return Choice(*items), i
```
